newsitem.title: USA: NL sees hiked titanium dioxide prices thru'97.
newsitem.headline: NL sees hiked titanium dioxide prices thru'97.

text.p: NL Industries Inc said it expects further increases in its titanium dioxide pigments selling prices during the second half of 1997.

The company, which operates the titanium dioxide pigments business through its Kronos unit, said the unit's average selling prices for the products during the second quarter of 1997 were 3.0 percenty higher than the first quarter and 8.0 percent lower than the second quareter of 1996.

At the end of the second quarter 1997, average selling prices were 1.0 percent higher than the average for the quarter, it said. Kronos achieved record second quarter sales volumes reflecting continued strong demand for the products, it said.
Kronos' second-quarter and six-month sales volumes rose 9.0 and 14.0 percent, respectively, from the year-earlier periods, with higher sales volumes worldwide, it said.
Kronos operating income in the latest quarter includes a $2.7 million gain related to the sale of surplus assets, it added.
